about: Request class -> device for 1bit serve --laya (RFC #186, docs/laya.md). A row may name any device the model can run on; a device not available for the model falls back to default. Change a row only with a measured net gain (decode and time to first token, the Laya decision included).

code.why: Vulkan decodes fastest on Strix Halo for every measured .gguf (docs/hrx.md, docs/serve.md); with DFlash2, code runs 45.7 tok/s on Qwen3.8-27B.

prose.why: Same device as code; DFlash2 and MTP are within 10% on prose (28.3 vs 25.8 tok/s, Qwen3.8-27B).

short.why: MTP beats DFlash2 on short replies (28.2 vs 17.8 tok/s), but the drafter is per server (per-request speculative settings are ignored, measured 2026-09-28), and a second 27B server for ~0.3 s per short reply costs ~16 GB and loses to the decision time.

long_doc.why: Prompt processing dominates: Vulkan ~330 t/s on a 1,838-token prompt (Qwen3.8-27B), HRX 43-88 t/s pp512 on that model (measured 2026-09-28).
